q: How does saving as PDF work?
a: Click Save PDF in the clean preview. Your browser's print window opens: choose "Save as PDF" as the destination (the browser remembers this next time), keep Margins on Default, and click Save. The PDF has real, selectable text and working links.

q: Does it upload the pages I save?
a: No. Pages are cleaned on your computer and your saved pages stay on your computer. There are no servers that receive your pages, and no analytics or tracking.

q: Why are some images loaded from other websites?
a: Many sites keep their images on separate image servers. Images from the page's own site are copied when you capture it; images hosted elsewhere are loaded from those servers when you preview or save, just as when you view the page (they see your IP address). You can turn images, or images from other websites, off in the settings.

q: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
a: Free lets you clean and save single pages as often as you like, and combine up to 3 pages into one PDF. q: Does it work with pages I'm logged in to?
a: Yes. It reads the page as your browser shows it, so logged-in pages work, including images from the same site.
